chapters.title: Chapter 612: Princess Arien
paragraphs: From feeling shy to falling into the arms of the one she was shy of... such a classic thing that only happens around the Chaos Dragon, who couldn’t decide when to make a lady blush a little and when to knock them off their feet—literally.
Kent held Princess Arien in his arms, and what should have felt like a couple of seconds to the beautiful princess now felt like a lifetime.

Kent’s beautiful purple eyes looked into hers, and while he could indeed compete for the universe’s most handsome, he still paled compared to most foxkin men in Fedora or most mean in the high worlds and immortal worlds.
However, that didn’t stop the princess’s ears and tail from twitching as he held her in his arms.
When her mind came back to her senses, she immediately pulled away, causing Kent to smile.
Princess Arien walked a little faster, creating distance between herself and Kent.
Behind them, Princess Lyra couldn’t hold back her laughter as she watched her sister’s flustered behavior.
Looking at her sister behaving like Cinderella made her burst out laughing. Thankfully, she missed her best friend Dori too much, so after a couple of laughs, she held back.
Eventually, Kent caught up with Princess Arien, who tried to move away again, but Kent spoke before she could walk away.
"I wonder what you wanted to ask so badly you ended up falling into my arms. Not that I’m complaining." At first, she tried not to answer, but eventually, she spoke.
"I just wanted to know how breaking a limit felt."
"It felt great," Kent answered, and Princess Arien paused in her steps, nearly causing Kent to bump into her. Not that he would’ve minded that.
"I am not asking it in that way... I want to know your experience from the moment you reached your limit to the point when you broke that limit."
Kent smiled. "You should have led with that. But to tell you the truth, my limit came out of nowhere, and before I realized it, it was broken.
However, the feeling is like..." Kent didn’t know how to put it, so he started turning around until his gaze landed on a tall mountain far in the distance.
"The feeling was like this. Take this mountain as an example—imagine it as an obstacle in front of you that you couldn’t break. No matter how hard you tried, you just couldn’t break it.
Now, imagine you wake up one day and suddenly find a way to break it, which, in my case, requires me to climb the mountain.
Then consider this feeling: the higher you climb, the stronger you become until you reach the top.

When you get to the top, you realize that if you were at the bottom again, a flick of your hand can easily obliterate the mountain. That is how it feels, and trust me, you will enjoy it when you reach that level and break your limit."

Princess Arien smiled defeatedly. It felt like a joke hearing that she would one day reach the limit and even break it. Had it not been for Dori, even her father wouldn’t know why he couldn’t break through due to this limit.
And while they know now, the things that go into reaching that level are something she just doesn’t see herself achieving.
"Thank you for telling me about your experience, but I don’t see myself reaching that limit just yet. But thank you," she said with a quiet smile.
"No need to look down on yourself. Reaching the limit is not that difficult. All you need is a much higher spirit root.
Of course, you are already at the Spirit Ascension stage, but that doesn’t mean you still can’t raise the grade of your spirit root," Kent said, and Princess Arien nodded.
"I know that. Lady Tala already told us that.

However, the reason why I said I don’t see myself reaching the first limit is that the item we can use to raise our spirit root grade is not something that can be acquired easily, and with the state of our world at this time, we can’t even start to think about chasing after it.
It will escalate things, and while I would love to say that won’t cause much problem, my people come first, so I won’t chase strength while putting my people’s lives in danger."
Kent smiled. "Very noble of you, Princess Arien. At least you are not like most power-hungry humans back in my world who would do anything for power."
Learning about what happened to Princess Lovina’s family and those behind it, he understood just how heartless people can be in their pursuit of strength.
So, hearing Princess Arien’s words, he could tell she genuinely cared about her people.
Such qualities are rare.
Most people in her stead would argue that sacrificing the lives of a few to gain strength and save the masses is justifiable.
However, that is a foolish and twisted way of thinking that isn’t only evil but also incredibly idiotic. Kent knew he wouldn’t do that.
Princess Arien is a swordswoman currently at the Sword Sage stage despite being at the Spirit Ascension stage.
However, despite lagging behind Sword King Shawn, she has battled many Spirit Kings and walked away with her life intact.
She even clashed with a few Spirit Emperors, which means she must possess a relatively strong foundation. Naturally, most of her power comes from her ability to control space energy.
She has six tails, which, per the bloodline of the Fox race, means the higher the number of tails one possesses, the greater their strength when it comes to controlling space energy.

Though her comprehension of space energy is just at the Very High level, still two levels from reaching the Perfect stage, she can use it in combat, and that alone gave her some upper hand even when clashing with those higher in realms than her.
So, she is powerful, but slowly losing confidence since she doesn’t know when she can break that limit and become even more powerful, and finally ensure her people are safe.
’Ah, what the hell, one of those fruits is just 100,000 tower points. I can practically transform her and her race into a bunch of freaks anyway.
However, I must wait for now and see what they decide. I am not petty, but a pretty face also won’t make me throw in all my wealth.’
Kent sighed and said, "Don’t worry too much about your limit. I am sure things will work out soon."

chapters.title: Chapter 613: Limit Breaking Task
paragraphs: "I will come fetch you when the king and the elders decide on your request," Princess Arien said before turning around to leave.

"I will see you later, Sister Tala," Princess Lyra also said to Dori before running after her sister. The small mansion they were given has four rooms, so since there are only three of them, it was the perfect spot for them.
"I will be inside cultivating," Sword King Shawn said before walking away. Now that Dori had solved his problem, he wanted to start early.
His prowess would skyrocket if he managed to break his limit and reach the Sword Emperor stage.
His sword intent and aura had also reached the peak of the Profound stage, so the moment he reached the Sword Emperor stage, he would break into the Heavenly sword intent and sword aura stage.
This would take his swordsmanship to a different level.
In the field of swordsmanship, the intent and aura can grow as far as the Celestial grade. It starts from Basic, which is most used by sword adepts, to the Master stage.

The Grandmasters and a few saints use the Enhance stage until they reach the Profound stage. Most swordsmen get stuck at this stage, simply because they must at least gain three enlightenments in the sword intent or aura path.
Most call it Sword Energy enlightenment.
Without gaining the three enlightenments, they wouldn’t be able to reach the Heavenly sword energy stage.
However, while meeting this requirement is sufficient, merely reaching the Profound stage is enough to elevate one from Sword Saint to Sword Sage and ultimately to Sword King.
However, to reach the Emperor stage, you must attain all three enlightenments. At the Heavenly stage, Sword Emperors, Monarchs, and Sovereigns use it.
Then they move to the Divine sword energy stage, where Sword Legends and Sword Divines can also use it. After those stages, the rest will depend on whether the swordsman can become an immortal.
To unlock Immortal Sword Aura and intent (Sword Energy), they must become an immortal and at least comprehend their Sword Realm into a Sword Law stage.
It’s all complicated and tedious, but as one starts to form the Sword Realm, they must continue to improve, shape, and sharpen it.

Once they reach the Sword Divine stage, where they will be introduced to the various paths in comprehending the Sword Dao, they will be required to comprehend the Dao and, in doing so, upgrade their realm into a Law realm.
This isn’t just about having a realm; they would now have a law that is controlled and improved upon by them alone. The stronger your Sword Law, the stronger its influence on people.
Most call it a Law concept, and it isn’t just for sword cultivators; it is for everyone, where your conceptual understanding will determine your strength.
Most swordsmen spend thousands of years here, comprehending their Sword Law. But in the grand scheme, Sword Law is basically one’s understanding of the path they are following.
So, until they form a Sword Law and become immortals, becoming one of the Immortal Swords is nearly impossible.
Of course, most swordsmen choose to put their swords down at the Divine stage and instead become immortals since they couldn’t form Sword Law.
The Immortal Sword stage is the best part because the moment they reach the Sword God stage, most consider themselves at the peak.
The Sword Supreme and Sword Celestial stages are ones that not many can boldly say they want to rise to. It’s challenging and demanding, but many have reached the Celestial stage.
But one might ask, is the Celestial stage the pinnacle of the swordsmanship path? This question was asked billions of years ago, and to this day, the answer remains unknown.
Kent didn’t want to think too much about that either, so he just sat there as Sword King Shawn walked away.
Sword King Shawn had already gained three enlightenments in the Profound Sword Energy stage, so he was ready to reach the Heavenly Sword Energy stage. Then gradually, he would reach the Divine stage.
"I was right to bring him to this world, where he can grow much faster. This is even good; one day, I might just need his help."
After relaxing for a while since Dori went back to the tower to do some things Kent instructed her to, Kent decided to add his points to his stats.
He first checked how many attribute points he had.
[Attribute Points: 3,400,000]
"Looks like the Bloodvein tribe is doing better than I expected." Kent smiled, looking at the number of points he had left to add.
He also checked his stats.
⟦ STATS ⟧
Physical Strength: 437,650
Physical Agility: 438,260
Physical Stamina: 437,625
Spiritual Strength: 634,275
Mental Strength: 454,665
"So that is 680,000 for each stat," Kent smiled. "Looks like I will become a monster after breaking this damn limit."
His smile bloomed as he commanded the two to add the points.
Powerful energy surged into his body, making him feel like he could easily punch a hole into the planet. However, just as the energy flowed into his body, it suddenly stopped, and messages appeared.
⟦ You have reached your maximization limit. To continue, you must first break your limit. ⟧
⟦ Limit Breaking Task: Kill Five Spirit Kings. ⟧
"Not that I did not expect something like this, but five Spirit Kings... that is a lot, but not impossible." A smile tugged at the corner of his mouth, making him sigh.
"The only headache now is getting to that pill princess... but even before that, I need to raise my alchemy skills to a whole new level.
If Shax wasn’t exaggerating, then it means my opponent is not a simple person. She is a monster in the alchemy path, and from the look of things, getting to challenge her will be a headache.
She had already gained five enlightenments in the Pill path, and I am yet to concoct a Tier 4 pill.
Ah, what a headache," Kent scratched his head. He may be strong and handsome, but this Pill Princess is proving to be a headache.

She can already concoct Tier 9 pills, and as someone who prides himself in the Pill path, Kent doubts she will lower herself to his level and accept his challenge when he can’t even make Tier 8 or 9 pills.
"I guess when I enter seclusion this time, I won’t be coming out until I am at the stage the entire world will fear me...
This means both my Bloodline, Soul, Sword, and Alchemy must be on a whole different level." Kent clenched his fist.

"Wait for me, Pill Princess, I will flip your world upside down and make you kowtow to me..." His laughter echoed in his room as he lay down and soon drifted to sleep, only to be woken up two days later by Dori.
The kings and their elders had arrived at a decision, so Princess Arien came to pick them up. Soon, Kent, Dori, and Sword King Shawn were back in the large hall.
A new face was sitting beside the king this time... a woman.

⟦ STATS ⟧
Physical Strength: 437,650
Physical Agility: 438,260
Physical Stamina: 437,625
Spiritual Strength: 634,275
Mental Strength: 454,665
"So that is 680,000 for each stat," Kent smiled.
"Looks like I will become a monster after breaking this damn limit."
His smile bloomed as he commanded the two to add the points.
Powerful energy surged into his body, making him feel like he could easily punch a hole into the planet.
However, just as the energy flowed into his body, it suddenly stopped, and messages appeared.
⟦ You have reached your maximization limit.
To continue, you must first break your limit. ⟧
⟦ Limit Breaking Task: Kill Five Spirit Kings. ⟧
"Not that I did not expect something like this, but five Spirit Kings... that is a lot, but not impossible." A smile tugged at the corner of his mouth, making him sigh.
"The only headache now is getting to that pill princess... but even before that, I need to raise my alchemy skills to a whole new level.
If Shax wasn’t exaggerating, then it means my opponent is not a simple person.
She is a monster in the alchemy path, and from the look of things, getting to challenge her will be a headache.
She had already gained five enlightenments in the Pill path, and I am yet to concoct a Tier 4 pill.
Ah, what a headache," Kent scratched his head.
He may be strong and handsome, but this Pill Princess is proving to be a headache.

She can already concoct Tier 9 pills, and as someone who prides himself in the Pill path, Kent doubts she will lower herself to his level and accept his challenge when he can’t even make Tier 8 or 9 pills.
"I guess when I enter seclusion this time, I won’t be coming out until I am at the stage the entire world will fear me...
This means both my Bloodline, Soul, Sword, and Alchemy must be on a whole different level." Kent clenched his fist.

"Wait for me, Pill Princess, I will flip your world upside down and make you kowtow to me..." His laughter echoed in his room as he lay down and soon drifted to sleep, only to be woken up two days later by Dori.
The kings and their elders had arrived at a decision, so Princess Arien came to pick them up.
Soon, Kent, Dori, and Sword King Shawn were back in the large hall.
A new face was sitting beside the king this time... a woman.

chapters.title: Chapter 614: Their Decision and The Odds
paragraphs: The new face in the hall was that of a woman whose hair was also white like Princess Arien’s, and judging by her impeccable, clean-cut bone structure, one wouldn’t need a genie to see that she was the queen.
"This is Queen Amorian, my wife. She was in seclusion when you arrived two days ago," King Hkum instructed his wife the moment Kent and his people sat down.
’A Spirit Emperor, huh?’ Kent recognized her aura, making him pay much closer attention to her. That was when he found out she was also a Sword Emperor.
’This lady is dangerous.’
As a swordsman, he could recognize the aura around her, and that sent chills down his spine. However, he was the chaos dragon, so why fear when you can go with the flow?
"Nice to meet you, Queen Amorian. I am Kent Madson... This is my uncle, Sword King Shawn." Since the Foxkins already knew Sword King Shawn’s identity, he didn’t hide it.
As expected, the Queen’s attention turned to Sword King Shawn as if she were gauging his strength. After a whole minute, a smile tugged at her lips.
"You weren’t exaggerating, dear. He really is powerful," Queen Amorian said, making Kent smile. However, the next second, the queen turned to him.
"I can tell you are also a swordsman. However, I can’t measure your true strength despite being only a Sword Grandmaster. This can be due to two things.
First, maybe your foundation is unstable, so your energy is not quantified.
The second being, your current understanding of the sword is too vast, too vast that your sword stage doesn’t have the means to measure your true strength.
So which one is it?"
Kent smiled, hearing her accurate take on his current understanding of his sword comprehension level.
His understanding of the sword was indeed very vast. This was due to Jest’s memories. Jest was a sword saint when he reviewed his memories the last time.
However, while that didn’t seem like much, his meeting the Sword Dao was something that affected even Kent so much that his understanding expanded vastly.
But while that was a factor, the second came into play when he bestowed the true name on Vexthra.
When he passed out, his consciousness was pulled into a realm where, aside from a rather large and tall sword hanging in the air, nothing else was in sight.
He didn’t know why he was pulled there or what to do, so all he could do was sit and stare at the sword. However, a few days into the staring contest, he started to notice something.

First, it was faint, but he saw the most concentrated form of sword aura, which later manifested into sword intent. Then, within a weak moment, the true form of sword energy appeared, which contained both sword intent and aura.
To his ladies, Kent was out for a couple of months, but in reality, he was out for 65 years. Throughout those 65 years, he had done only one thing: comprehend sword energy.
This caused his sword intent and sword aura to skyrocket to the profound stage. However, that is not all.
While he indeed managed to take his sword intent and aura to the profound stage, his understanding of them was far more extensive than that of anyone wielding a profound sword aura and intent.
This meant that if he were to clash with someone now, his understanding of profound sword aura would be several levels above theirs.
So what Queen Amorian said was indeed true.
"It depends on how you want to see it, Queen Amorian. My understanding of the sword is indeed vast; however, compared to someone like you, I am but a bug before you."
"A bug that can challenge someone with 9th-level comprehension of Profound Sword energy," Queen Amorian said with a smile.
This discovery, of course, made the King and his elders look at Kent strangely. Even the two princesses and the two princes were having a hard time hearing all this.
"I guess someone who has broken a limit is worthy of having such prowess. However, your second request—are you sure you have what it takes for such a task?" Queen Amorian asked and then continued.
"While you can perhaps contend with Spirit’s Ascension cultivators, the odds you will be going against include dozens of Spirit Kings and even a Spirit Emperor.
It is not a major stronghold, but rather a barracks where our people are being held. However, even so, the odds are just too much for someone like you."
Kent smiled and asked, "Would a Spirit Sovereign appear?"
"No," Queen Amorian answered.
"Then there shouldn’t be a problem. The Spirit Kings and Emperor will indeed be a challenge; however, I don’t think that will be an issue.
Provided no Spirit Sovereign appears, my team and I will do just fine."
"And this team you speak of, are they Spirit Kings? Because that is the only way you can handle this barracks and get our people out.

And the reason why no Spirit Sovereign will appear is that our warriors would also clash with any reinforcement from either the Hellhounds or the Batkins." Queen Amorian struggled to see where Kent’s confidence was coming from.
Although she said the Spirit Kings were a few dozen, in fact, there were 24 of them, 200 Core formations, and 100 Spirit Ascensions, not forgetting the Spirit Emperor. The odds were indeed massive.
"The strongest in my team are at the peak of the Root Sovereign stage, but they fight like immortals." Kent smiled, showing his white teeth.
This—everyone was dumbfounded, hearing what Kent had said.
They expected him to say something like he had a team of Spirit Ascension and a few Spirit Kings, but Root Sovereigns, not even Core Formation; that was just too much to take in.
"I know you all are skeptical, so why don’t you meet one of them?" Kent said.
"How?" King Hkum asked.
"I will summon him here now."
They turned and looked at each other before nodding in unison.
"Very well, let’s see the team you’re placing your bet on."
Kent smiled and called forth.
"Aetheris, come out."
Immediately after he called out, the temperature in the hall started to rise as a 12-meter giant made of lava appeared, holding a colossal hammer.
They all turned pale.

chapters.title: Chapter 615: Unnatural Army
paragraphs: One thing to note about the limit on worlds is that it only affects a person’s cultivation. This means that if an immortal descends to a medium world, only their cultivation will be suppressed to the Core Formation stage.

Of course, since they need their cultivation base to release their immortal aura, being suppressed won’t stop them from unleashing a much more powerful presence than a normal Core Formation stage expert could release.
This was why, when Aetheris, the second strongest in the Eternal Wrath Legion, appeared, the aura he released was that of a Spirit King at the peak.
But that wasn’t all; when the king and his people laid their eyes on him, they felt a fear that only comes from being under the aura of someone several times stronger than themselves.
And that was possible because Aetheris is an Immortal King suppressed by the dungeon to the Peak of the Sovereign stage.
"This is Aetheris," Kent said, smiling at the king and his people. A few seconds later, Kent turned to Aetheris, "Buddy, can you take away the heat?"
Aetheris nodded, and just like that, the heat inside the hall vanished, making everyone sigh. Aetheris also lowered his height to 2 meters.
"Hello everyone, I am Aetheris, a Flame Warden with perfect affinity for the Flame element." He may be made of lava, but that didn’t prevent him from smiling.
"So what do you think, Queen Amorian? Does this prove I can handle this mission?" Kent asked.
"He is powerful; however, that doesn’t mean he alone can make a change. But let’s assume there are more like him out there.
Can you truly promise this mission will be a success? The Hellhounds took some children too, and we would want them to come back alive."
If the Foxkins attack and even manage to rescue their people, the hellhounds will hit back hard next time. So this mission will be without their interference.
"Since you will meet them soon anyway, why don’t I bring all of them now?" Kent smiled and started summoning his legion.

Kaizo was the second to come out, looking smug as ever. Then Vaelros followed, bringing his imposing presence like the brute he is. He is the second brute in the undead legion, but instead of using his fist, he uses enchanted chains.
Sylara appeared, bringing her evil presence that made Princess Lyra move and hide behind her mother. Kent laughed when he saw this.
Zareth appeared next, chewing on an apple—something Kent nearly slapped him for. The classic appearance with an apple in hand was something Kent had invented, but now Zareth had stolen it.
’I have to create a new entrance move.’ Kent smirked but didn’t say anything to his strongest Undead, who had the power of the World Serpent running through his veins...

Skoggr appeared, but the moment the Foxkins set their sights on him, they nearly drew their weapons. After all, Skoggr was an orc, and the foxes hated the orcs. However, Kent told them he was not from this world.

Kent had contemplated bringing him, as he was familiar with the history between the Fox and the Orcs. However, after a few considerations, he realized Skoggr’s appearance would be even better than he had hoped.
Imagine an orc attacking the allies of the Orcs; that would indeed cause some chaos. He was looking forward to that.

Khaazal also appeared, wielding his Spear of the Tempest. After him, Nykali, the Shade King, appeared, further terrifying everyone, considering his head is a skull. Of course, he wasn’t offended when everyone became wary of him upon his appearance.
If anything, he was thrilled to incite such a reaction from them. The fear in their eyes made him feel a sense of relief—a rather twisted bastard who thrived on the fear of his opponents.
His backstory would be something else.

Kazarak, the Beast Warden with a lion’s head, also appeared. Yet again, the foxes became wary of him because they hated the Lionkin. However, this was beneficial for them, as Kent’s plan would be much more chaotic for the orc alliance.
Veera, the necromancer, also appeared. Then Gorzak, the second orc, also appeared. He is a barbarian orc, so his presence didn’t cause much reaction.
Valtor, the panther assassin, also appeared, keeping his presence as quiet as he could. As an assassin, he was someone who valued silence and shadows.

Irina, the strongest in Kent’s legion, appeared, dragging Veydris with her. Naturally, the moment she appeared, everyone knew she was indeed the strongest simply because they couldn’t sense any aura from her.

Zharkaz, the dragon with a broken horn, also appeared. For him, that dragon arrogance came with him, and since dragons are naturally regarded as the peak of the beast race, the foxes felt this primal fear when he arrived.
But Kent made sure he didn’t ride on their fear, so he just stood to the side, arms folded. Then Vorthar, the demon lord, appeared.
Lastly, the ice beauty, Ankaara, appeared, bringing her natural charm with her. In fact, when she appeared, all the intimidating aura in the hall vanished, replaced by a calm and loving presence.
This raised her status in the heart of the foxkins higher than that of her friends. Kent observed this lineup, and a smile appeared on his lips.
But he didn’t stop there. The next minute, a red-skinned beauty appeared. Kent wanted his women to join the battle, too, so he called them to join the team.
Velyra was the first to arrive, followed by Vari. Elaine was third, followed by Elsa. Lilian also appeared. The Unity also came.
Lani, Selene, and Ingrid appeared simultaneously. Neomi, Alina, Zaila, Mara, and Camilla also appeared simultaneously.
Nara and her friend Lani also appeared, with Vexthra appearing last. She stood beside Kent since she wouldn’t be fighting, only spectating.
However, looking at the lineup, the king and his people were taken aback.
"What do you think? Can I handle the task now?" Kent asked.
They didn’t even need to answer that. The moment the first six appeared, they knew Kent had what it took to handle the task.
Their cultivation base was indeed lacking, but the army before them was unnatural. They could tell they were much stronger than they looked.
"When will you be attacking the Hellhounds?" Queen Amorian asked.
"Tomorrow. By then, I will finish setting everything up that will leave the Orc Alliance in shambles by the time I am done."
Kent laughed. "When I am done, the Hellhounds and the Lionkin will be the last of your problems."

chapters.title: Chapter 616: The Creator of Chaos (1)
paragraphs: "So what is the plan, master?" Kaizo asked, now back inside the tower. After Kent received the go-ahead from King Hkum and Queen Amorian, Kent sent his undead army away, but the ladies decided to stay and explore the city much more.
Dori and the two princesses went with them, while Kent and Sword King Shawn retired back to the residence they were given.
Sword King Shawn went back to his cultivation, while Kent entered the tower to plan the battle he and his legion would soon embark on.
"The plan is, first, nobody is allowed to die," Kent smiled. "As for the battle that is about to happen, the odds are against us, but that doesn’t mean we can’t handle it.

First, as you all heard, there are some Sovereigns and Core Formation Hellhounds present. But knowing you all, they are as good as dead. This leaves the 100 Spirit Ascension, 24 Spirit Kings, and the Spirit Emperors.
Aside from that, we also have to rescue the prisoners. This means that while we handle the fighters, some of you will sneak in and take out those guarding the prisoners, then lead them away.
That won’t be easy. However, it is doable. However, while that sounded like a good plan, we won’t be doing that.
We will do the opposite. Instead of rescuing the people during the battle, we will do that first and then rain fire on the hellhounds."
"How do we do that?" Zareth asked. Kent turned and pointed toward Veydris, Irina, and Valtor. "You three will handle the rescue."
Everyone became puzzled. They knew Valtor was nearly invisible to most senses, but Irina is not like him, nor is Veydris, so why then would they join him?
If anything, Nyxira should be the perfect person to join him since she is practically a shadow, like Lani and Vari. However, Kent just smiled.
"The reason for choosing the three of them is simple. While Valtor is perfect to infiltrate the base undetected, he will be discovered the moment he uses this." Kent produced a Tier 10 talisman.

"This is a Tier 10 Teleportation talisman that can teleport everyone within a 40-meter radius. The moment he activates it, the Spirit Emperor there will notice, and while I would love to say Valtor has what it takes to face him, it will be a lost cause on his side.
Which is why Irina and Veydris will come with him. They can use the Void to get to him the moment he activates the talisman and intercept the Spirit Emperor.
This means Irina and Veydris will fight and kill the Spirit Emperor."

Kent looked at Irina, and she smiled confidently. Veydris just stood there, not minding anyone. He may be a Transcendent, but now that his Void comprehension is at the Perfect Stage, he can handle the battle.
Irina, being the strongest in his legions, means she is perfect for this battle.

"Now, we still have 24 Spirit Kings to handle. While I would love to say we can easily do it, the truth is we are outnumbered. However, we have Aetheris, so it is possible we can do it." Kent turned to the Flame Giant.
"I know you want to fight, and you will, but for the first thirty minutes, I want you to use your Flame Domain to trap ten Spirit Kings. Can you do it?"
"Yes. Ten is not a problem," Aetheris answered.
"Very good. This leaves only 14 for us to handle. This responsibility will fall on Veera and Nykali. Veera, you are a necromancer who can summon undead.
However, I don’t want you to summon hundreds of them; I just want you to summon the ten Core Formation undead you have."
Zareth and his undead friends smiled weakly, hearing this. ’Looks like she went easy on us when we fought her.’
She indeed went easy on them when they were clearing the dungeons. But now, she had to be serious and unleash her full power this time.
"You will handle five Spirit Kings. You don’t have to kill all of them if you can’t, but make sure you have them locked down."
Veera nodded.
"Nykali, you have a spectral army, right? Use them to handle another five." The Shade King nodded with a bony smile.

"My wives will handle the four left. Then come the 100 Spirit Ascension Hellhounds. They are a bigger Odd, but they are weaker than the Spirit Kings... so everyone except Skoggr, Gorzak, and Kazarak will handle them."
"But master, what about the Sovereigns and Core Formation?" Sylara asked.

"I will handle them quickly. That is why I want Aetheris to hold back ten Spirit Kings. The moment I am done with the Sovereigns and Core Formation, which shouldn’t take over twenty minutes, I will come for the Spirit Kings."
His legion nodded. They didn’t doubt his words simply because they knew their master wasn’t weak.
"Then what would I, Skoggr, and Kazarak be doing since we don’t have a mission?" Gorzak, the barbarian Orc King, asked.

"Oh, your mission is very important." Kent smiled evilly and explained their mission. By the time he was done, his legion could only pity the Orc alliance for making an indirect enemy out of their master.

Sword King Shawn went back to his cultivation, while Kent entered the tower to plan the battle he and his legion would soon embark on.

This means that while we handle the fighters, some of you will sneak in and take out those guarding the prisoners, then lead them away.

We will do the opposite.

Kent turned and pointed toward Veydris, Irina, and Valtor.
"You three will handle the rescue."
Everyone became puzzled.

"The reason for choosing the three of them is simple.

Irina, being the strongest in his legions, means she is perfect for this battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 617: The Creator of Chaos (2) [Bonus]
paragraphs: "So our job is to make sure the Four Spirit Kings are dead," Vari asked, and Kent nodded. After hours of going around Emberwood City, they returned to Dori’s small mansion, where Kent was staying.
Although they were offered a much larger building, they chose to stay with Kent in the small mansion, which raises the question: How are they all going to fit in it?
However, Kent wasn’t concerned about that. His mission now was to ensure his ladies understood the assignment.

"Yes. There are 16 of you. Four against one is already good enough for beauties like yourselves. However, if you manage to handle them much faster, you are free to pick a new target. Don’t worry, there will be more targets for you, so have fun."
If people in Sonox heard Kent say "Have fun" to a bunch of beauties who had no business fighting Spirit Kings, they would probably curse him for forming a harem full of monsters.

"That is good, then." His wives were happy to be joining their man on a mission, finally. Vexthra, who was leaning on Kent’s body, smiled. She knew that the moment her Primordial spirit formed, she would be able to use it to fight as well.
However, for now, she could only observe and cheer them on. After going over a few details, the ladies left to have dinner with the princesses while Kent slipped into the Sword Tower.
He still had 12 hours before the mission was scheduled to start. That was 12 days for him to stockpile attacks using the Fractured Void.
He knew the odds this time were greater, so he was preparing accordingly. Twelve hours later, he and his team moved out. However, they weren’t the only people who left Emberwood.

Queen Amorian and her children, except Princess Lyra, followed them. Of course, they wouldn’t join the battle; they were just there to observe, while General Ragnar and his men would make sure no reinforcements came.
The Hound Barracks is one of the three barracks owned by the Hellhounds. They are some of the most destructive beasts in the universe.
Naturally, they are blessed with fire affinity, which makes them natural users of flames.

The barracks are located in the outer sections of the Hellhound territory. Kent and his team would have to travel through the Hyilaz Valley, one of the many natural valleys in Fedora, to reach their destination.
Of course, since the Hellhounds are much closer to the Foxkin, Kent and his team only had to travel 15,000 miles before they saw the tall, dark barracks standing in the distance.
The environment there isn’t like the beautiful forest of the Foxkin; this space is a lava-infested land. The temperature there is hot, and the flames burning around are all dark.
"Good luck, Valtor," Kent said to the assassin who would be making the first move. He nodded and left. A few seconds later, Irina and Veydris also entered the void.

Kent turned and looked at Queen Amorian and her children. "You can observe from here. However, when the battle starts, you can come closer for a better view." With that, he and his team, along with his ladies, started moving closer to the Hound Barracks.

Meanwhile, Valtor kept moving from one shadow to the next, drawing closer to the barracks. His presence was gone, but if you pay much closer attention to your surroundings, you could sense him with a powerful sense.
The Hellhounds inside the barracks and those outside were not paying much attention. That is what happens when you think you are on the winning side.
They believed they were on the winning side simply because they were allies of the strongest being in the entire Fedora.
They didn’t have much to fear, so they decided to lower their guards—something that was about to cost them dearly.
Inside the barracks deep underground, 18 Foxkins could be seen locked behind two thick doors. Standing in front of these doors was a 2-meter-tall, muscular humanoid Hellhound.

His skin was cracked, and molten lava seemed to move through it just like every other Hellhound out there. They had thick skin, muscular physiques, and well-built bodies, and from what Kent knew about them, they possessed incredible strength.
That, augmented by their flame affinity, made them very powerful. This one was a Spirit Ascension stage Hellhound standing guard.
Inside, almost half of the Foxkins were children, and judging by the wounds on the adults, it was clear they had been beaten while protecting the young ones.
The look in their eyes as they gazed at the Hellhound guard said it all—they hated the bastard.
Suddenly, a young Foxkin noticed a shadow move, causing her to turn to an older Foxkin. But the adult Foxkin sealed her lips before she could speak.
He and the others saw this movement through the holes in the metal door, so they made sure none of the children said anything.

Suddenly, Valtor rose from the shadow of the Hellhound guard, and before the bastard could notice him, he slit his throat with one hand while the other embedded a dagger into his chest, ending him instantly.
Not even a strand of killing intent came from Valtor. This showed he was someone who had mastered the art of "Death Killing."
He could kill to his heart’s content without showing any killing intent. These individuals were among the most notorious assassins. Valtor opened the prison door and entered.

"I am Valtor. My master sent me to get you out. Now, gather in one place." The Foxkin who saw him kill the Hellhound easily obeyed him. His entire body was covered, so nobody could tell what he looked like.
Valtor waited, and soon the Foxkins were gathered.
’I am ready, Irina. The rest is on you and Veydris.’ For someone who didn’t like to talk, he understood the assignment today, so he gave his friends a heads-up.
He activated the talisman, which enveloped everyone, including him.
However, at the same time, several meters away, a door burst open and a figure flashed out. But before he could move, a dark crescent-shaped sword arc came from the void, stopping him.
The void cracked, and Veydris and Irina walked forward. Irina wore a smile on her face for a second before a cold look replaced it.
"To the death then." She vanished, and without even giving the Spirit Emperor a second to ask a question, her fist landed on his chest, sending him flying out of the barracks.
"Kill them all," Kent’s voice sounded as he appeared in the air with his legion and harem.
A great battle was underway.

chapters.title: Chapter 618: The Creator of Chaos (3) [Bonus]
paragraphs: The first person to attack was Kaizo.
His fist was coated in golden lightning, forming a gauntlet around it. He came down hard, landing a powerful punch on the ground, creating a resounding crack.
The buildings cracked in half, and the shockwave knocked many off their feet. This gave Kent a good chance to quickly handle as many as he could before the chaos consumed everyone.
"Fractured Void."
The void opened, and thousands of sword arcs rained down on them. The core formation and sovereigns were killed on impact, and the few Spirit Ascension that were struck sustained grave injuries.
"Aetheris," Kent called out, and the flame giant fell from the sky and landed heavily on the ground. He took on his full twelve-foot height, so when he landed, he towered over everyone.
"Flame Domain: Chained Prison."
His voice boomed as the fire on the ground burst out. Chains shot from the ground, latching onto the legs of ten spirit kings who immediately lost control over their cultivation base.
"It is done, master," Aetheris said.
Kent gave him the mission to take care of ten Spirit Kings. Kent knew that his domain was perfect for this.
Because of Aetheris’s perfect control over the flame and his natural affinity for flames, he created a domain with three forms.

The Chained Prison is the third form, which basically holds anything the chains lock onto for thirty minutes. Within those thirty minutes, if the chain even manages to latch onto a Spirit Lord, they will lose their cultivation.
However, there is one big problem with this form of the domain. Those who are locked cannot be attacked. It is a prison for them, and the only way to attack is if Aetheris frees them.
It is a nice domain skill. However, that condition on it is just too restrictive. Still, that is fine... The moment Kent handles his targets, he will come for the Spirit Kings trapped.
And he wasn’t the only one who would be coming.
Unity, Velyra, Lani, and Lilian were locked in with a level 5 Spirit King. Unity stayed at the back, firing arrows at the Spirit Kings while her sisters got closer.
Since Unity was the weakest among her sisters simply because she hadn’t awakened her true name yet, her sisters didn’t want her to get closer to the chaos.
However, what none of them expected was that, while Unity was the weakest among her sisters, she was the one among the four fighting the level 5 Spirit King hellhound to land lethal attacks.

This made the hellhound angry, and every chance it got, it tried to get closer to Unity. However, with the harem connection that required no essence to use, Unity was basically using it to teleport from one sister to the next, evading the bastard.
Her lightning arrows were lethal. And since she wasn’t really in any danger, whenever her arrow left her bow, the hellhound found himself in a complicated situation.

Lilian took on her fire elemental form, which, inside this region, made her very powerful. Thanks to the natural domain of fire below them, she was using half the effort to unleash powerful fireballs.
Her fireballs were imbued with the essence of flame, so whenever they landed on the hellhound or he defended against them, the shockwaves hit him deep inside.
It was like a soul attack, but this was directed at the flame core inside the hellhound.
"Flame Serpent." Lilian waved her staff, and a large serpent made purely of dark flames burst from the ground and rose into the air.
The energy around it was scorching hot. "Get him."
The serpent hissed and dove at the hellhound, who unleashed barrages of attacks with his sword. However, Velyra was a step ahead and unleashed blood arcs that cleaved through the flame arcs.
The shockwave was tremendous. With the road cleared, the snake appeared before the hellhound and burst into a sea of flames, pushing the hellhound back.
"Haha." A mocking, twisted laugh came from the shadows where the hellhound landed. Suddenly, Lani emerged from the shadows and stabbed her dagger at the hellhound.
However, he twisted and evaded the attack, even launching a counterattack. Before his blow could land, Lani’s laughter filled the air again as she vanished.

In her place, a three-meter-long arrow appeared and landed on the hellhound’s chest. It was meant for his head, but he managed to shift his body at the last second, so the arrow struck his chest and came out from the back.
"And he bleeds." Velyra smiled, tapping into one of her overpowered bloodline abilities: [Blood Poison].
The coordination between the four sisters is just beautiful.
Kent moved through the barracks, now cracked and in flames, killing every Sovereign and Core Formation expert he saw on sight.
They were basically bugs before him because the strength coursing through Kent’s veins was something they couldn’t measure.

They couldn’t match his speed even in his human form. His strength was monstrous, and while he hadn’t broken the second limit yet, his power was enough to handle hundreds of Sovereigns and Core Formation experts.
The more he killed, the more soul essence he absorbed. After becoming a Tier 12 Soul cultivator, his [Soul Absorb] skill now worked passively.
This meant he didn’t have to manually absorb the souls of those he killed, which then turned into soul essence.
Now it was automatic: the more he killed, the more soul essence he gained. After killing the 90th hellhound, a message appeared before his eyes.
⟪Congratulations, you have reached Tier 13 in soul cultivation.⟫
⟪You have received a soul skill: Soul Torture.⟫
⟪Do you want to keep leveling up or store the soul essence?⟫
’Hmm, this is the first time I’m being asked this. I’d better check what it does.’
"Store." He gave his command as he continued to move. He didn’t know why he had to store the essence, but since he could use it later, he wanted to see what else he could extract from it.
"Soul Torture, huh? Let’s see what you’re made of." Kent picked a Spirit Ascension hellhound who sustained minor injuries from his opening attack and used Soul Torture on him.
This hellhound’s soul is just Tier 12, so he was an easy target...
Immediately, he used the skill, something happened that caused him to widen his eyes...
"Damn..."

Let’s see what you’re made of." Kent picked a Spirit Ascension hellhound who sustained minor injuries from his opening attack and used Soul Torture on him.
This hellhound’s soul is just Tier 12, so he was an easy target...
Immediately, he used the skill, something happened that caused him to widen his eyes...
"Damn..."

chapters.title: Chapter 619: The Creator of Chaos (4) [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Isn’t the name a bit misleading? Soul Enslavement would be a rather good name for it," Kent mused, moving through the air.
"Well, temporarily, Soul Enslavement will be good too, considering the person dies within ten minutes after the skill is used."

The moment Kent used the skill on the Spirit Ascension hellhound, something happened. As the skill took effect, he gained access to the person’s entire soul, which in some twisted way gave him the ability to command him.
Of course, just using the skill is enough to kill him, but now, he could torture him and even command him. That was akin to temporary enslavement in Kent’s opinion.
And he hates slavery.

⟪The master is overthinking it. This is not enslavement; it is more like commanding a soldier, only this time, they won’t have the means to say no, which, now that I think about it, does sound like slavery.

But on the bright side, torturing and commanding him—well, I say commanding him—seems more decent. Torturing him is not ideal in this big battle, so better command him to aid you in the ten minutes he has left.⟫
Kent smiled, hearing Gaia’s words. ’I guess she made a good argument. In that case, why don’t I make him useful for now?’

"Kill every Sovereign and Core Formation hellhound you see." The moment he gave the command, the hellhound jumped into the air and started raining arrows on the hellhounds, who couldn’t understand what was happening.
"What is Brizno doing?" The Spirit Kings locked down by Aetheris wondered when they saw the hellhound under Kent’s control, killing his fellow hellhounds.
But it didn’t take long for three more to join in. Soon, the total number of Spirit Ascension stage hellhounds fighting for Kent rose to ten, shocking the trapped Spirit Kings.
"What is happening?"
"Who are these people, and where did they come from?"
They couldn’t understand what was going on. Chaos surrounded them everywhere. The battle had started six minutes ago, but the death toll on the hellhounds’ side was staggering.
One could argue that they were caught off guard. However, that was nonsense considering they were being held back and killed easily.

The Shade King Nykali was tasked with holding back five Spirit Kings. He was doing just that, and even looking at the wounds on the bodies of the Spirit King he was actively battling, it was clear he would soon emerge victorious.
Nykali could summon spectrals from ancient battlefields to fight for him. However, he hadn’t done that since he awakened a new power that allowed him to create his own spectrals.

Right now, thirty spectral knights were holding back four of the Spirit Kings, while he held back the fifth. However, instead of feeling overwhelmed, he was rather having the upper hand in the battle.
The reason was his scepter. The staff-like weapon in his hand was more dangerous than any weapon being used on the battlefield.

The scepter contained a crystal called the Spirit Crystal. It absorbed nearby spirits, which Nykali could then use to amplify his attacks. The stronger the spirits, the more powerful and devastating the attacks became.

And while he hadn’t killed anyone yet, Kent had already killed loads of Sovereigns. The Undead Legion and the Eternal Wrath Legion had also killed some Spirit Ascensions, so there were more spirits he could use.
This was why he held the upper hand and the only reason the Spirit King would soon be dead.
Meanwhile, Veera was also battling hard while her undead army held four Spirit Kings back, just like Nykali’s spectral knights.
She was battling a Spirit King using her sword skills. Surprisingly, despite being a necromancer, she was also a Sword Sage with profound grade sword energy under her control.
This gave her an upper hand over her opponent, who was using his fist.

In fact, despite being slower than the Spirit King, she was doing her best to keep up, and judging by the wounds on the body of the Spirit King, one had to say she was nearing the end of her first battle.
As for the rest of the undead, the battle was growing even more devastating around them. Kaizo was having the time of his life.
He may be the weakest in the legion so far, but that doesn’t make him the weakest on the battlefield.

In fact, thanks to being humiliated over the past few months by Gorzak anytime they spar, Kaizo has grown much more powerful since then. It was like getting punched made him stronger, and indeed, that is one way for him to grow.
He was holding his own against the Spirit Ascension stage hellhounds, and that alone shows his potential is far more dangerous compared to people still at the Root Transcendent stage.
"Skybreaker Fist." Kaizo jumped high into the air and then came down, landing a powerful punch on the hellhound he was fighting. The punch sent him flying back.
The moment the hellhound struck the ground, thunder echoed in the clouds, and then a thick lightning bolt tore through the sky.
"Heaven’s Judgment."
The thick lightning bolt landed on the hellhound, piercing a hole through its chest. Just like that, Kaizo killed his first Spirit Ascension warrior.
The body vanished into Kent’s NecroForge, and Kaizo smiled. "Master, did you see that? Just 70% of my strength was enough to solo a Spirit Ascension expert... hahaha."

"Yeah, well, you better get moving. The bodies you kill will be used to upgrade you and awaken your true name, so get punching and please, use your full strength. I don’t want to use more bodies to resurrect you."
Kent smiled, watching his first undead, and from what he knew, the one who would one day become the leader of the undead legion became happy after killing a Spirit Ascension stage hellhound.
He didn’t know what to say. Kaizo is monstrous, just like the rest of his brothers and sisters. Speaking of his sisters...
The second team from the harem consists of Vari, Elsa, Selene, and Zaila. Just like Unity’s team, they are also handling one of the four Spirit Kings that Kent tasked them to handle.
It can be said with confidence that they are exceeding Kent’s expectations.

chapters.title: Chapter 620: The Creator of Chaos (5) [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Astral Blade Fall"

Selene activated a skill, summoning dozens of radiant swords to fall on the hellhound like meteors. She and her sisters were coordinating their attacks well, something Vexthra, who was standing far away, seemed happy about.
She analyzed their skills and battle styles and then formed the teams accordingly.
As Selene’s summoned swords rained down, Elsa moved close to the hellhound, unleashing three sword arcs that sliced through the air, arriving at the same time the summoned swords did.
The hellhound, being a spirit king, was able to raise a shield around himself. The swords and arcs landed on it, creating a small crack.
"Now," Zaila said, and Selene moved. Her sword vibrated, unleashing Celestial energy from it. She stabbed her sword forward, landing on the shield created by the hellhound.
However, it couldn’t go through.
The shield was much more powerful than they anticipated. However, that wasn’t something they hadn’t seen coming. In fact, that was what they were aiming for.
The moment her sword landed on the shield, Zaila made her move.
"Mind Shock."
She unleashed a mental attack that struck the bastard hard in the head. This caused the hellhound to lose control of the shield. And when he did, Vari was there with her white hair, waiting for him.
"Bye, stranger."
Just like that, the spirit king who could bring any middle world to its knees lost his head. Vari looked at the headless body vanish into the Necro Forge, a smile playing on her lips.
"Good work, ladies... Now, let’s go handle the Spirit Ascension first." They trusted their sisters to know they would be able to handle their opponents, so they didn’t even consider helping them.

Thankfully, Vari’s team had Zaila, who was just too powerful for her own good. Despite her primordial spirit now being at Tier 1, her mind space was so vast that her Tier 12 mind attacks managed even to affect a Spirit King.
That shows just how important it is to have a bigger mind space or a soul sea, or other spaces yet to be discovered. The bigger the spaces, the more you can utilize your skills.
The moment the first spirit king was taken care of, it became an open market for more to fall prey to. The second team to handle their spirit king was Alina’s team.
From the start of their battle, Alina stood back, drawing in the air. Only Camilla, Mara, and Elaine were fighting.
But even so, they weren’t struggling much, considering they had all become monsters in their own right. They managed to hold the Spirit King back long enough for Alina to complete her formation.

Thankfully, seven minutes later, she was done, and that was when the battle also came to an end. A large sword formed in the air, and the formation locked the Spirit King’s body down, causing the sword to pierce through him.
His body was pinned to the ground before it vanished into the forge.

"Now, I can easily draw that formation in under four minutes." The ladies smiled, hearing Alina’s words. She possessed a skill that enabled her to draw formations and arrays she had previously drawn, much faster.
"Zaila and the others are done and killing the Spirit Ascensions. Let’s go there," Elaine led everyone toward the Spirit Ascension, who didn’t know what was about to befall them.
Not that they had a chance to begin with. The sword Alina drew was just Tier 10.
However, it held the power of the Eternal Grid, an Ancient power that only she could control. This made all her formations stronger and much more deadly.
Unity also managed to drive an arrow through the head of the Spirit King after the one she sent through his head. Her accuracy was impeccable.
She made sure her sisters distracted the bastard for just a second, but that was enough to give them the upper hand against their opponent, who died hating Unity.
As for the last Harem team, they were taking more time simply because their Spirit King was Level 9, just a step away from becoming a Spirit Emperor.
So they were having a hard time.
However, a team containing Ingrid, Neomi, Nara, and Val isn’t one to worry about. They are the selected few in the Dragon Harem who have a unique set of abilities.
Take Ingrid, for example. She is a Voidling, someone who has the Void as her primary source of energy. This means she is fast and deadly. She isn’t the average Sovereign.
Then there is Neomi, who is now fighting in her Shara form. Basically, she was reeking with death qi, and that alone makes her terrifying.

Then there is Nara, a half-Wraith, half-human. She is also a night rider who has the power to harness the flames of hell. Essentially, she is all about killing, which makes her a dangerous individual.
Then there is the Moon Goddess, who can become a literal god at any time and bring the last Hellhound to their knees.
However, ten minutes later, they ended their battle too and joined their sisters. Kent, who had seen these outcomes, knew he had to get on task and handle the five Spirit Kings.
He knew his wives were powerful, but never expected them to be this monstrous.
"Ladies, be a flower, and handle the rest of the Core formations. I need to go handle my business now." They nodded, and Kent moved.
"Alright, Aetheris, release one Spirit King." Aetheris nodded, and one chain on the Spirit King he held in the chained prison broke, freeing him.
The moment he was free, he moved and landed a punch on one of the chains binding his teammates. However, the next second, a powerful beam shot from the chair, drawing a hole through his chest.
He died.
"Dumbass. Anything you throw at the domain bounces back to you, ten times stronger," Aetheris said, his voice booming.
The nine Spirit Kings turned pale, glaring at Aetheris and Kent. Aetheris just smirked and released another one. This time, the released Spirit King knew better, so he didn’t attack the chains.
"Die, invader." Instead, he shifted his attention to Kent, who stood there looking at him. His fist came close to landing on Kent’s body.
However, that didn’t happen; instead, his body froze mid-attack, eyes wide as he slowly fell back and died.
"Damn." Kent, who killed him, was even taken aback.
Inside the chest of the Spirit King was a thick, five-meter dark shard. The Doom Shard he never truly paid attention to had proven to be much deadlier than he thought.
"Well then, Aetheris, release two this time." A smile appeared on Kent’s face as he waited for his next two targets.

chapters.title: Chapter 621: The Creator of Chaos (6) [Bonus]
paragraphs: For a Root Sovereign to be asking for two Spirit Kings as his opponents... it just didn’t make any sense. However, Aetheris nodded to Kent’s words and released two Spirit Kings.
Kent looked at them and made a "come get me" gesture. As if taking the provocation to heart, the bastards dashed toward him with a speed that rivaled even a Spirit Emperor.
Their anger burned so hot that they wanted only one thing: to kill the brat who seemed to be the cause of everything.
However, even when they drew closer, Kent didn’t move. Instead, he stood there and allowed the two to unleash a powerful attack that landed on his body.
Instead of breaking in half, Kent was only pushed back a couple of meters. He felt the impact and saw the print mark appear on his skin, but that was all.
The ultimate move that was supposed to kill him did no such thing.

"I didn’t use my dragon bloodline, and I most certainly didn’t activate any enchantments in these clothes... so does that mean just my stats alone are enough to handle the blow from a Spirit King, or does this have to do with the limit I am breaking?"
Kent was taken aback.
"Again," he called out, and the enraged Spirit Kings growled, their fists burning red. They activated a skill that amplified their strength. However, even that didn’t break Kent in half.
He was just pushed back, and the pain was much more severe now.
"Again."

For some reason, Kent felt like asking for some more beating, so he asked. Thus, the two Spirit Kings started bombarding him with punches. Soon, his body was littered with dark marks showing he was being beaten severely.
"This guy is nuts," Prince Sylas said, his eyes widening as he gazed at Kent being bombarded with attacks for the past five minutes.

"Just what is he made of? I mean, taking a punch from a Spirit Ascension stage expert is doable, but two Spirit Kings—that is just too much," Princess Arien added, not understanding what was happening.
Her mother stood there quietly, observing the battle with a calm expression.
She was paying attention to two people: Kent and Sword King Shawn, who was only targeting Spirit Ascension Hellhounds.
At first, Sword King Shawn was on a winning streak, having killed three Spirit Ascension experts. However, that was until he met a peak Spirit Ascension Hellhound who also used a sword.
Though it is not common for Hellhounds to use swords, this one looked like a worthy opponent, so Sword King Shawn had been locked in battle with him for the past ten minutes.

Every second of his fight with the Hellhound swordsman was a mesmerizing display for Queen Amorian. She had expected Kent to take out his sword, but, alas, the brat was more focused on getting beaten.
"Are you two children, put some weight into your punches... I am not feeling anything at all," Kent taunted. And he was lying; the pain was not lessening at all.
However, he wanted more, and as such, he was getting pounded. But he wanted more.
Meanwhile, far from the crumbling barracks, a 60-meter-tall Hellhound radiating hell flames was in a stalemate with Veydris and Irina.
The Spirit Emperor that was fighting was monstrous. Initially, they had the upper hand; however, when the Hellhound took on his true form, the odds shifted to his side.

However, it took just a few minutes for Veydris to bring the odds back to a stalemate. He unleashed an attack that raised something akin to a Void domain. Inside this domain, none of them could use any active skills.
Naturally, that was a bad move. However, both Veydris and Irina have an affinity for the Void, so it was like they were swimming in the Void. This allowed them to hold the beast in a deadlock.
But that was only if they could hang on for a few more minutes.
Valtor, who used the talisman to free the prisoner, was back on the battlefield but hadn’t shown himself yet. Kent told him to come and hide and wait for his chance to appear.
So he was hidden and waiting.

Twenty minutes had passed since the start of the battle, and so far, the odds were on Kent’s side. His team had ensured that the overwhelming odds stacked against them had now been lessened and shifted to their side.

Suddenly, Irina was sent flying through the air as the Spirit Emperor used a desperate method to break the stalemate. It was a skill that made him channel all his energy into his mouth and blast it at Irina.
However, he didn’t stop there; he went ahead and dashed at Veydris, ready to end the metal knight who seemed to have the means to calculate all his attacks before he landed them.
This time, Veydris was a step too late to take any action. So the Hellhound found that opening and unleashed a powerful kick.
It was that one kick that would KO Veydris.
He came close, very close to achieving his goal. However, before he could reach Veydris, a shadow flashed at the corner of the Hellhound’s eye, sensing something dangerous.
He stopped the attack on Veydris and attempted to retreat. However, Valtor, who saw the perfect time to move, timed it perfectly and unleashed a lethal attack.
His dagger cut deep into the right foreleg of the Hellhound, and then Valtor vanished just like that.
The next second, he appeared, hovering in the air. He looked toward the Hellhound, a smile on his lips behind his mask.
"You have five minutes to live; enjoy it while it lasts." With that, he vanished, leaving the fate of the dying Spirit Emperor to Veydris and Irina.
Valtor appeared inside the legion and vanished to the last floor of the dungeon he came from. The moment he appeared there, he fell unconscious.
The skill he had just used required him to use all his soul strength, which was only at Tier 11, to go against a Tier 13 soul and poison it.
That was dangerous, but he succeeded, and the price would be a couple of months unconscious.

They activated a skill that amplified their strength.
However, even that didn’t break Kent in half.
He was just pushed back, and the pain was much more severe now.
"Again."
For some reason, Kent felt like asking for some more beating, so he asked.
Thus, the two Spirit Kings started bombarding him with punches.
Soon, his body was littered with dark marks showing he was being beaten severely.
"This guy is nuts," Prince Sylas said, his eyes widening as he gazed at Kent being bombarded with attacks for the past five minutes.
"Just what is he made of?
I mean, taking a punch from a Spirit Ascension stage expert is doable, but two Spirit Kings—that is just too much," Princess Arien added, not understanding what was happening.
Her mother stood there quietly, observing the battle with a calm expression.
She was paying attention to two people: Kent and Sword King Shawn, who was only targeting Spirit Ascension Hellhounds.
At first, Sword King Shawn was on a winning streak, having killed three Spirit Ascension experts.
However, that was until he met a peak Spirit Ascension Hellhound who also used a sword.
Though it is not common for Hellhounds to use swords, this one looked like a worthy opponent, so Sword King Shawn had been locked in battle with him for the past ten minutes.
Every second of his fight with the Hellhound swordsman was a mesmerizing display for Queen Amorian.
She had expected Kent to take out his sword, but, alas, the brat was more focused on getting beaten.
"Are you two children, put some weight into your punches...
I am not feeling anything at all," Kent taunted.
And he was lying; the pain was not lessening at all.
However, he wanted more, and as such, he was getting pounded.
But he wanted more.
Meanwhile, far from the crumbling barracks, a 60-meter-tall Hellhound radiating hell flames was in a stalemate with Veydris and Irina.
The Spirit Emperor that was fighting was monstrous.
Initially, they had the upper hand; however, when the Hellhound took on his true form, the odds shifted to his side.
However, it took just a few minutes for Veydris to bring the odds back to a stalemate.
He unleashed an attack that raised something akin to a Void domain.
Inside this domain, none of them could use any active skills.
Naturally, that was a bad move.
However, both Veydris and Irina have an affinity for the Void, so it was like they were swimming in the Void.
This allowed them to hold the beast in a deadlock.
But that was only if they could hang on for a few more minutes.
Valtor, who used the talisman to free the prisoner, was back on the battlefield but hadn’t shown himself yet.
Kent told him to come and hide and wait for his chance to appear.
So he was hidden and waiting.
Twenty minutes had passed since the start of the battle, and so far, the odds were on Kent’s side.
His team had ensured that the overwhelming odds stacked against them had now been lessened and shifted to their side.
Suddenly, Irina was sent flying through the air as the Spirit Emperor used a desperate method to break the stalemate.
It was a skill that made him channel all his energy into his mouth and blast it at Irina.
However, he didn’t stop there; he went ahead and dashed at Veydris, ready to end the metal knight who seemed to have the means to calculate all his attacks before he landed them.
This time, Veydris was a step too late to take any action.
So the Hellhound found that opening and unleashed a powerful kick.
It was that one kick that would KO Veydris.
He came close, very close to achieving his goal.
However, before he could reach Veydris, a shadow flashed at the corner of the Hellhound’s eye, sensing something dangerous.
He stopped the attack on Veydris and attempted to retreat.
However, Valtor, who saw the perfect time to move, timed it perfectly and unleashed a lethal attack.
His dagger cut deep into the right foreleg of the Hellhound, and then Valtor vanished just like that.
The next second, he appeared, hovering in the air.
He looked toward the Hellhound, a smile on his lips behind his mask.
"You have five minutes to live; enjoy it while it lasts." With that, he vanished, leaving the fate of the dying Spirit Emperor to Veydris and Irina.
Valtor appeared inside the legion and vanished to the last floor of the dungeon he came from.
The moment he appeared there, he fell unconscious.
The skill he had just used required him to use all his soul strength, which was only at Tier 11, to go against a Tier 13 soul and poison it.
That was dangerous, but he succeeded, and the price would be a couple of months unconscious.

chapters.title: Chapter 622: The Creator of Chaos (7) [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Such a pity, I never knew Spirit Kings would be this weak," Kent said, shaking his head. He had already endured close to ten minutes of beatings from the Spirit Kings, and now, even their punches weren’t hurting him anymore.

He knew this had something to do with his body tempering, so he hadn’t paid much attention to the pain from the beginning, but now that he had stopped feeling the pain, he knew what needed to be done.
"Time for you two to die." Kent blinked, and the next second, he was 4 km away from the two Spirit Kings. Then the void cracked, and four sword arcs flew out.
These four attacks were from the second form of the [Annihilation Sword] technique, [Void Cleave]. This form of the technique depended heavily on the distance between Kent and his targets.
And since he moved back 4 km, the distance was rather vast, so when the attack emerged from the void, it began gathering power from the 4 km it had to travel.
The Spirit Kings at first didn’t sense anything, but when the attack was 1 km away from them, fear pressed down on them.
This forced them to move and evade the attack. However, to Kent’s shock, something he never expected to see happened.
The Spirit Kings couldn’t move their bodies, which was shocking considering they are three realms above Kent.

However, they couldn’t move, so they were forced to defend themselves. However, when the attack landed on them, the shield they created was severed in half, and the powerful force behind the Void Cleave landed squarely on their bodies.
Boom.

They were hurled through the air, landing hard on the ground. One of them lost both hands since he crossed them as a form of defense. His body was battered and bruised all over, and his chest was cut open.
The other died from having half of his body cut off. He managed to die with one arm intact since he didn’t use both hands to defend himself.
Kent appeared beside the barely alive Spirit King and drove a [Doom Shard] through his head, killing him instantly.
"Just two more to go," Kent smiled and gestured for Aetheris to send two more.
Far away, Queen Amorian wore a shocked expression when she saw the outcome of Kent’s single attack. She wondered just what could be so powerful that Spirit Kings couldn’t even defend against it.
However, looking at their dead bodies, she knew even she would have struggled to defend against it. And she was probably right.
The Void Cleave attack was one that Kent had yet to determine how far it could go. In fact, he had yet to determine if the distance could extend as far as several hundred miles.
So far, the farthest he had gone was 4 km, and the results were devastating, so he wanted to see how far and how strong this sword skill could be.

Aetheris released two more Spirit Kings, leaving only four, with three minutes before the four would be freed. The battle had been going on for 27 minutes already, so he was nearing the 30 minutes he could hold them.
Kent knew what had to be done, so he didn’t let the two Spirit Kings play around. Well, one of them started to run when he was released, causing Kent to smirk.
He didn’t chase after him; instead, he used a soul attack on him, shaking his soul. That split second of pain that went through his body made Kent grin.
"You don’t really think I will let you run, do you?" Kent opened the Void, and hundreds of attacks rained down on the bastard.
His shamelessness was just too much. For such a powerful person to choose to run—that was just too shameful.

So Kent sent him away under the rain of attacks from the Void. The twelve days he spent inside the tower weren’t for play. He had saved thousands of attacks in the Void that he was now using to handle the Spirit Kings.
After the fourth Spirit King died, the second started to beg. However, Kent didn’t listen and rained down attacks on him as well.

The moment the fifth Spirit King fell under his assault, Kent felt his body start to grow stronger. His mind remained the same, but as for his soul, he just couldn’t comprehend how monstrous he was becoming.
The process didn’t happen instantly. It was as if things were changing inside his body, so he let it happen, and slowly, his strength continued to grow.
"Release them all, Aetheris." Kent was on a whole new level of strength, so with only a minute left, he asked for the Hellhounds to be freed.
When they were freed, all four of them attacked him.
However, he stood there smiling at them. Just when they were a meter from him, Kent’s sword appeared, and his Profound Sword Intent and Qi burst out, pushing them back.
The sword came from the sheath, and before the four could understand what was happening, Kent executed a series of attacks that created thin lines of sword arcs that cleaved through their bodies.
Two were able to react quickly, coating their bodies with their energy. However, the other two were not so fortunate and succumbed to the attack.
It was a deadly move he learned from Jest.
He never had profound sword intent back, so he never tried it, just like how he never used the ’Limitless Sword Arc Domain’ skill again until he became a Sword Saint.
Kent looked toward the two who sustained some damage and was about to attack when Skoggr, the Orc Chieftain, spoke to him through telepathy.
’We have arrived at the location, Master.’
Kent nodded and turned to Aetheris. "They are all yours."

The Flame Brute smiled and reduced his size to eight feet. "Shall we dance?" Just like that, the dance of flames started as Aetheris began bombarding the two living Spirit Kings with powerful flame attacks.

Kent looked at his ladies, who were now helping Veera and Nykali handle the Spirit Kings that Kent had assigned to them. He then looked at Veydris and Irina, but they were doing fine, considering Valtor had made sure they had the upper hand.
Sword King Shawn was also doing fine, although he had sustained some injuries, he would live.
Kent smiled and vanished. The next second, he appeared on a mountaintop where Skoggr, the Orc Chieftain, Gorzak, the Barbarian Orc King, and Kazarak, the Savage Warden, were.
Ten kilometers away stood a large camp housing thousands of Lionkin soldiers...
