chapters.title: Chapter 646: Primordial Spirits Awakened (2)
paragraphs: While Kent was deep asleep, working on awakening his Soul Path, his ladies were also becoming monstrous over time.
So far, Zaila had already climbed to the 930th step after breaking the limit on her mind and body. It was a huge leap for her. But she wasn’t the only one making progress.
Elsa had already climbed to the 790th step and had become a Diamond Body cultivator, so her next target was the Sage Body stage. Slowly, she was nearing that huge threshold.
Meanwhile, Ingrid and Neomi were also steadily climbing. Ingrid took a few months to ensure her beast companion, whom she decided to call Mini, was also acquainted with the Golden Titan Stairway.
Since Mini couldn’t take on a human form due to her Void lineage, Ingrid helped her climb to the 600th step, which took just seven months.
Thankfully, Mini adapted and could now handle it on her own, so Ingrid joined her sisters to climb while they waited for the rest of their sisters to emerge.
Next to come was Selene, who awakened a Lunar Space, to the amazement of everyone. It was then that they all knew—aside from the Mind and Soul, there were other spaces out there.

The Lunar Space was one beautiful place, even more beautiful than Zaila’s Mind Space. It had a mesmerizing design featuring many gardens filled with some of the most beautiful creatures in the universe.
There were beautiful birds, unicorns, centaurs, and even dragons. However, every one of these creatures was made from Lunar energy, unlike Zaila’s own, which were real.
Selene speculated that they had a purpose, and even a few could communicate with her verbally. But unlike Zaila, who had a technique to summon her creatures to fight for her, Selene didn’t have that.
But that wasn’t too bad. She had her Tier 17 Primordial Spirit regress to Tier 1, so her Lunar Space had become so vast that she had yet to understand all the new changes occurring within it.
Not that she had to worry about that. The Lunar beings inside her Lunar Space would do all the work. She was amazed by how the world appeared within her Lunar Space.
Perhaps they should call it more like a Primordial World, capable of sustaining life. In short, Selene too had become a monster, which made Kent even more dangerous.
His wives were growing, and it was for the best.
She also joined her sisters on the Golden Titan Stairway. Elsa had already reached the 810th step and, thankfully, had become a Sage Body cultivator.
The treasures they received at every 100 steps climbed were doing wonders. They all wanted to be at least the 4th stage, which in this case was 1,200 steps, before Kent emerged from seclusion.
They wanted to surprise him, so they were working hard, and it was already starting to show. Ingrid also became a Sage Body when she stepped on the 800th step and received her treasure.
A few months after Selene came out of the Primordial Space, Alina walked out with a cheerful smile on her face. Her sisters stopped what they were doing to see what she had gained.
They always stopped climbing the stairs whenever a new sister emerged from their Primordial chamber.
Alina awakened Grid Space. She already possessed an ancient energy that she incorporated into her arrays and formations, known as the Eternal Grid. It turned out to go beyond just energy.
Her Grid Space had everything to do with arrays and formations. There were trees inside her Grid Space that had drawings of ancient arrays and formations on them.
The stones even contained some complex arrays that she could use whenever she wanted.

The Grid Space was, in actuality, one massive formation drawn from the Eternal Grid itself. One of the best parts was that when she awakened the Grid Space, her Primordial Spirit used the time difference in the tower to draw thousands of arrays and formations before regressing from Tier 17 to Tier 1.
Of course, one could say she and her primordial spirit could communicate, and later Alina herself could draw them. However, there was one thing about Alina’s new overpowered abilities.
Anything drawn by her Primordial Spirit could be activated with a snap of her finger. This meant the thousands of arrays her Primordial Spirit created were just a snap away from being activated.
Also, with a snap, she could replicate them without having to draw every last symbol again.

This was why, when she came out of the Primordial Chamber, the first thing she did was see Elaine’s parents, and with a snap of her finger, she broke the curse restricting Elaine’s father’s bloodline.
She even planted an array on Lady Rain’s soul. This was so she could give her a Life Magic constitution when her Primordial Spirit rises back to Tier 15.
Inside her Grid Space were thousands of unique constitutions she could give to anyone she wanted.

The only downside was that, unless she became a Grid Emperor, which would allow her to draw Tier 15 to 17 arrays, she would have to wait for her Primordial Spirit to rise back to Tier 15 before she could give Lady Rain a unique constitution.
The arrays for such things ranged from Tier 15 upwards.
But they were unique and from the Eternal Grid Codex itself, so unless the heavens intervened, Lady Rain would soon have unique abilities she could rely on to cultivate herbs like her husband.
But that could wait.
Lady Rain was just happy that her husband could now rise as a Life Magician, whose dream was to become a powerful healer who would handle the injuries of the people inside the tower.
Alina herself was just too happy. She could now draw Tier 12 arrays.
And soon, she could handle Tier 13. Then, when she surpassed Tier 14, she would become an Array Emperor, which in her case meant she would be called the Grid Emperor.
Then again, that too could wait for now.
Although she did not need a strong body to draw arrays, she also wanted to improve her body cultivation since their big sister Vexthra had told them it would come in handy when becoming a god.
After Alina finished all that, she joined her sisters on the stairs.

chapters.title: Chapter 647: Primordial Spirits Awakened (3) [Bonus]
paragraphs: The Primordial Spirit’s awakening was supposed to start ten years after they entered the primordial chamber, but it began in the seventh year with Elsa. Now, ten years since they entered, five had already awakened their Primordial spirits.

Lilian walked out, radiating both Ice and Fire Qi. Her aura was in sync, and as someone who has both Fire and Ice affinity, being able to release both Qis at the same time showed she had taken a massive leap in her cultivation.
She awakened the Elemental Space, where half of the space was for Ice and the other half for Fire. It looked incredibly powerful.
In the Ice part, there were towering cliffs made entirely of ice, featuring white, snowy trees and frozen lakes, as well as frozen gardens and Ice beasts. It was like the Ice Age in there.
However, on the fire side of her elemental space, there was lava almost everywhere—lava rivers, lava beasts, lava mountains.
Basically, everything in there was of flame essence. And the best part: there was a castle that stood between the ice and fire domains, making it half ice and half fire.
Lilian gained the ability to harmonize her fire and ice, enabling her to harness both simultaneously and combine them for powerful attacks.

However, before her Tier 17 Primordial Spirit regressed to Tier 1, she helped Lilian form the foundation for a technique they worked on during the 10,000 years spent inside the Primordial chamber, despite only ten years passing inside the tower.

It was a technique that, even at its basic stage, was terrifying. They called it Elemental Queen Lotus. So far, what she had managed to achieve was just the bud of the lotus, but that alone showed the terrifying nature of the technique.
After spending four months to achieve that, she joined her sisters on the stairs. She didn’t want to spend too much time on something she had little understanding of yet.
After she reached the level she wanted to be at on the Golden Titan Stairway, she would work more on it. After all, she had nothing but time on her side.
The next to emerge from the Primordial Chamber was Camilla, she who walked out with a calm wind surrounding her, one that indicated she had awakened a type of wind element.
Of course, this was matched by her Primordial Space, which, just like her True Name, was called the Dawn Space.

As its name suggests, the space was always at dawn or resembled dawn, making her feel strong whenever she was there. And as someone immortal at dawn, one could already imagine how monstrous she had become.
Her Primordial Spirit, which resided in the Dawn Space, was always at peak strength, and this applied to Camilla, the owner of that space.
Inside her Dawn Space, the Moon was always full, indicating that she, like Selene and Val, also had a moon affinity.
The best part was that her Pegasus was also inside her Dawn Space and had already reached the Peak of the Core Formation stage, just like her master.
Aside from that, one of the spirits inside the Spear of Dawn had awakened, making the spear much stronger.
Three warriors had wielded the ’Spear of Dawn’ before Camilla.
Of course, the question was whether they were her incarnations, but the first to awaken was Lynn, the last to wield the spear before Camilla.
This awakening unlocked part of the spear’s previously locked powers. This meant that the moment Serelya and Elyndra awakened, the true might of the spear would be unleashed.

Camilla also brought out her Pegasus to climb the stairs since Ingrid’s Void Beast was doing the same and had even reached the 700th step. The best part was that her Pegasus could, to some extent, assume a demi-human form.

However, it would take some time for her to assume a perfect human form, like most Beastkins. However, it was not necessary, considering that aside from being Camilla’s mount in battle, she would spend most of her time fighting alongside her.
Being in her Beast form was perfect for said tasks.
Once everything was in order, Camilla joined her sisters on the stairs as they waited for the arrival of the rest of her sisters.
Zaila had reached the 1000th step, yet she still hadn’t attained Nirvana. However, it wasn’t as if she was seeking that.
Her focus now was to break more limits on her body, and reaching the 1000th step had broken yet another limit on her mind and body, making it four so far.

Climbing from the 900th step was a challenging endeavor. The pressure weighed not only on her body but also on her mind, and while it had nothing to do with Mind cultivation, Zaila couldn’t help but sometimes think of giving up.
Most of the time, she spent weeks on a single step, fighting against the pressure and slowly adapting to it. It was a crazy climb, and now that she had seen the rewards, she decided to rest.
However, when she drifted into her Mind Space, she got the shock of her life. This prompted her to give a rather important heads-up to her sisters.

"We shouldn’t give up, sisters. The pressure doesn’t just challenge us; it also helps our Primordial Spirits grow faster." Just like that, the secret to helping their Primordial Spirits improve faster had been discovered.

Three years ago, Zaila’s Primordial Spirit was at Tier 6, but now she had reached Tier 8, and it had only been three years. That showed just how much they were benefiting from the pressure on the steps as they climbed.

Under normal circumstances, her Primordial Spirit should have risen to at least Tier 7, as the Ancient Path to godhood isn’t as easy as regular cultivation. It takes time and considerable effort to cultivate.

So, for such a treasure to give them this boost, who would be foolish enough not to continue climbing? What Zaila didn’t know was that the treasures the Tower was giving them were much more precious than they appeared.
However, since it was a good thing, they could continue to receive it. After all, they weren’t getting it for no reason. They were working for it...

chapters.title: Chapter 648: Primordial Spirits Awakened (4) [Bonus]
paragraphs: Vari came out of the Primordial Chamber after Camilla, looking nothing like how she entered.
Naturally, she was an assassin, so it was expected of her to walk out clad in black. However, she walked out in white armor with white hair.

Of course, this begs the question: has she fled from the darkness and chosen to become an angel? But, of course, the answer was given in a form of transition that occurs from head to toe, changing into her darker side.
Her hair turned from white to black, and so did her armor.
This was because she awakened the Yin-Yang Space. Naturally, this means she now has both light and darkness affinity. And that was precisely what she was meant to be.
Her Darkness Element was the yin, and the light was the yang, and in all, she remained an assassin.
Ironic when you think about it. Someone who uses the light element as an assassin—it just doesn’t make sense, but in truth, it was that part of her that made her dangerous.
Most assassins, or those with a darkness affinity, tend to be limited when they face someone who uses the light element.
Light and darkness don’t blend, but for Vari, she had gained the power to walk hand in hand with both light and darkness, just like Lilian, who has a dual elemental affinity.
Inside her Yin-Yang Space, there is darkness on one side and light on the other, showing her affinity for both.
And as someone whose elemental mastery has already reached the perfect stage, she has become more than dangerous. Her Tier 17 Primordial Spirit regressed, and Vari joined her sisters on the stairs.
Then came Nara, who awakened the Hell Space. That space is natural to all Night Riders, but each has unique touches that are special to the owner.
For Nara, who is half human, half wraith, there is a special place inside her Hell Space that can be called Wraith Space.
There is a hefty tome with a special technique that once took the Wraith Queen from the ashes to the peak hidden inside the Wraith space.
The Wraith Spirit Art was once a powerful technique known only to the Wraith Queen.
This Wraith Space is small, but what it houses is something that could bring chaos to the entire universe if discovered.

However, inside her Hell Space, nobody can find it unless, of course, she willingly allows them access. Not that they could take it out, considering her Primordial Spirit is one of the most terrifying spirits ever awakened so far.
She was at Tier 18 when she regressed to Tier 1. But that wasn’t the terrifying part. All Night Riders have an affinity for the Hellflames.

However, while Nara herself has perfect control of the Hell Flame, her Primordial Spirit’s affinity is already at the Harmony stage, two stages above Nara. However, that isn’t all; she also possesses the Hell Flame Art.

If all flame arts in existence were ranked, the Hell Flame Art would be in the top three, and she had already mastered the first two stages of this terrifying art, something Nara had yet to start herself.
When her sisters found out about this, they all wondered if this was natural for all Primordial Spirits. It just didn’t make any sense.

Not only are their Primordial Spirits special, but they also seem to be utterly different versions of themselves. In the end, they concluded that all of this had something to do with their True Names.
But if Nara were to keep her Primordial Spirit at Tier 18, then even Empyreans would fear her, mainly because the Hell Flame Art is dangerous.
For now, her danger level has been reduced since her Primordial Spirit is now at Tier 1. However, she is not to be underestimated.
After Nara, Lani also emerged with her classic Joker laughter, oozing both Shadow and Death Qi. She awakened the Shadow Space, and with it came the shadows of the slain.
All beings she had ever killed were there inside her Shadow Space. However, while that looked concerning, it was the Shadow Domain inside her Shadow Space that looked even more concerning.

That part of the space came about when her Primordial Spirit regressed from Tier 17 to Tier 1, expanding the Shadow space. Inside the domain are millions of shadows that, at first glance, you would know are not ordinary.
Immortals, Demigods, and a few gods. Perhaps if she had ever killed a Supreme or Celestial, their shadows would find their way there.
Kills from the past are now inside her Shadow Space. However, they don’t move, and she also can’t make them move. They stand there, their intimidating presence evident.
And since her Primordial Spirit has no idea what to do with them either, she just ignored them and focused her attention on climbing the Stairs.

It was a weird space, but when Elaine appeared, it got even more bizarre. She appeared with Life & Death Space. Inside, life is on one side and death on the other, just like Lilian’s Ice and Fire Space or Vari’s Yin-Yang Space.
On the side of life, there is green life everywhere—potent herbs and nourishing waters. But on the death side, everything there is death.
Nothing that reeks of life can be found there. Even when Elaine picked a green plant from the life side and tried to send it to the death space, the moment she stepped in, the plant withered.
It was an instant withering that even shocked Elaine. This made her wonder what would happen to those she put there. Would they die instantly?
The answer remained a mystery, and since Kent told them not to allow anyone aside from their sisters to enter each other’s spaces, she wouldn’t test that theory.
But she also has the Tree of Life in her life space, which so far has only three green leaves. On the death side, blank tombstones could be found in random places.
She doesn’t know what will come out of those graves, but she is looking forward to that.
After helping her Tier 17 Primordial Spirit regress, she joined her sisters on the Stairs. They are all climbing steadily, making sure they catch up to Zaila.

chapters.title: Chapter 649: Soul Universe [Bonus]
paragraphs: When Kent fell into a deep sleep, he truly fell asleep. It was a rather good sleep, one that, if intentional, would have left him happy and fulfilled. However, this wasn’t the case for him since this was controlled sleep.
The five years of sleep were resounding. However, in the sixth year, his consciousness awakened inside a very dark space. There was nothing but darkness.
Kent, of course, didn’t know what was happening, but he didn’t want to remain in that darkness for long. Thankfully, a few months after he woke up in the darkness, a light appeared.
Tiny at first, but as the months passed, it began to grow large, filling the space. Eventually, he could see as far as his eyes could see.
Perhaps that distance was just a few meters from him, considering the entire place was white, so he doesn’t know just how far it went.
He regretted wishing for light. So he closed his eyes, and for unknown years to come, he remained in the darkness until today, when he heard a voice.
"Hello, stranger," the voice jerked him awake. When he opened his eyes, it took him three good hours to adjust to the light.
But when he did, his eyes fell on perhaps the most handsome man he had ever seen. Chaos came close, but he wasn’t quite on the level of this man.
He had white hair, perfect bone structure, and his golden eyes made Kent question whether his own purple eyes could look that dreamy.

The man allowed him to get whatever weird and shameful thing he was thinking about out of the way. Naturally, it took Kent a while. After admiring the man’s handsomeness, which made him jealous by all standards, his eyes landed on something else.
The man had no aura at all, and even Kent’s Enchanted eyes were not working. This could only mean one thing: he was stronger than Kent’s eyes could see. Kent’s curiosity was piqued.
’He is strong. In fact, he is stronger than Chaos, which begs the question: Who was this man?’
Kent looked at the man for a few minutes before he asked, "Who are you?"
The man looked at Kent, too, as if determining something. After a few minutes, he smiled and said, "I approve. You are worthy to carry this mantle."
"As for my name, I can’t say, because I go by many and have lived many, just like you have." Kent arched his brow, hearing what the man said.
"I can call you Kent Madson, but if you like, I will call you Chaos, or do you prefer Faceless? Though Jaqen is not a bad name if you ask me."
For every name the man mentioned, Kent found himself wondering just what the hell was going on. However, instead of feeling scared or violated, he was rather happy.
That was what made him wonder what kind of hell he had found himself in. But in the end, he had to answer: "You can call me Kent."
"Then, Kent, do you know why you are here?" the man asked, and Kent smiled. It was his turn to monologue.
"Under normal circumstances, I would say that was a stupid question, considering you can read my mind and already know why I am here.
Also, you seem to be the one who brought me here, so why ask this? However, since I know you can perhaps kill me with a snap of your finger, I will forgive you and answer your question.
I am here because I have a soul cultivation path in my soul that I am trying to awaken." Kent smiled in the end.
The man stared at him for a few seconds before bursting into resounding laughter.
"You are funny, Kent. I like that. Not only are you crazy, you are also unyielding. Adding that to your sense of humour, I say you have what it takes to take on this mantle."
Kent smirked, but he was happy being praised by this man whose strength, according to Kent’s estimation, was even higher than a Celestial.
"Very well. You are here because of this:" The man took out a cube. It had no writings on it; it was just a plain golden cube.
"This is the soul path you are after. It is the reason you are here. But before I tell you what it does, what can you tell me about soul attacks?"
Kent thought for a moment and answered, "Soul attacks are attacks that affect the soul directly by ignoring physical defenses."
"That is indeed true. However, what if I were to tell you soul attacks can affect the physical body too?" the man asked.
"I will say this is my first time hearing that. Soul attacks are meant to affect only the soul." Kent was puzzled to hear something this ridiculous; however, the man smiled.
"That is true, but with the path you are about to walk, you can attack both the body and soul. I don’t have much time, so I’ll try to summarize everything.
First, the path is called Soul Universe, and as its name suggests, you will indeed cultivate a universe within your soul.
This means you will create planets, starfields, galaxies, and more. You will be able to develop celestial bodies, such as stars and moons, and even simulate human life.
However, while the idea of creating humans or beasts may sound appealing, this path is intended solely for battle.

So the moment you bring them out, their job is to kill and be gone. Additionally, I’m unsure how far life created using this Soul Art will extend, but I’m sure that it has endless potential. Do hold it firm." The man smiled.
"Imagine plucking stars and throwing them at your opponents, throwing galaxies at your enemies. I say that is something you shouldn’t take for granted.
Of course, it will take a lot of hard work and energy, but with consistency and unyielding determination, you will one day rise to the peak with nothing but your wits."
The man’s figure started to fade away.
"So you still won’t tell me your name?" Kent was in shock, but seeing the man fade away, he wanted to know something about him at least
"Train hard, Kent Madson. Soon, we will meet again; perhaps this time, I will be the one who needs your help."
Kent watched the man’s figure gradually fade away. However, before his presence completely vanished, he said a few last words.
"I look forward to meeting you again, Kent Madson. And you can call me The Paragon."

chapters.title: Chapter 650: Soul Path Awakening (1)
paragraphs: "Paragon," Kent muttered, looking at the cube floating where the man with the white hair had stood just a few seconds ago. He expected a name, but he only got something akin to a title, or perhaps a symbol.
"Makes me wonder why lately I have been getting weird names," Kent smirked. "First, it was Chaos, then there was Faceless, and now, a Paragon who, from the look of this, is very terrifying."
"My life is funny," Kent laughed, and he touched the cube. He examined it for a few minutes...
"...though he is a nice dude. A little easy on the eyes, but he is a nice guy." He smirked yet again and then decided to ponder what Paragon said.
"First, I will be cultivating something akin to a universe inside my soul. Only that everything inside this universe is a weapon. The planets, the moons, stars, asteroids, galaxies, and so forth.
It is my universe, so I can do as I please. I say, not a bad move... Though I doubt it will be easy." Kent smiled, a happy expression on his face as he examined the cube curiously.
"He also said the humans or beasts I created will all be weapons in one way or another. Not that I planned on doing that, unless, of course, these humans or beasts can make a difference in combat."
The soul path he is about to embark on relies heavily on his soul essence. With enough soul essence, he can create anything.
Of course, he doesn’t know how much will go into creating these celestial bodies, but it will be a universe.
He will determine how many galaxies there will be, how many starfields he has to create, and even how many planets to include within a single starfield.
On those planets, he has to create everything like the moons, mountains, and every other thing. And since everything he makes can be used as a weapon, the possibilities are infinite.

"I don’t know where this path came from, but it is something that will indeed make Celestials go to war over. I’d better utilize it well, and if possible, create me a few planets that I can throw at people," Kent laughed, remembering what Paragon said.
Paragon gave him an idea, and as someone who believes that Chaos is the only way, he would most certainly make sure he throws planets at people.
"The guy is not only dangerous, he is also crazy. I’m looking forward to meeting him again. Perhaps next time I will learn a thing or two about him."
With that, Kent brought it close to his chest. "Moment of truth." He pressed it against his chest, and it dissolved inside, or more like melded into his chest.
However, the moment that happened, Kent blacked out and fell into yet another deep sleep. This time, too, when he woke up, he was in a dark space.
But he didn’t remain in the dark for long. The cube appeared and burst into radiant light, filling the space. The light spread, and soon, it started creating something akin to the cosmos.
No planets or galaxies were created. Instead, a large expanse of space, beautiful as it could be, was brought into being. First, all the colors were created.
Then this color diffused into a mesmerizing display of cosmic space, something that holds some form of meaning.

Kent watched all this slowly come to life with a calm expression. He didn’t know why he was given this by the mysterious entity named Paragon, but he was sure that with what was happening in front of him, he would, in one way or another, become someone worthy of his name.
An entire universe to himself, and judging by what he knew now, everything within it is a weapon he can use. That is more than excellent.
Suddenly, ten massive tomes appeared out of nowhere and hovered before Kent.
He wondered where they came from, but before he could even scan them, they burst into sparks of light and entered Kent’s forehead, causing him to pass out again.
This time, he was out for a while, and during his absence, the cosmos slowly took shape, expanding several light-years away. It was very beautiful, and at the center was Kent’s floating body.
After what appeared like forever, Kent opened his eyes, feeling a slight headache. However, after a few minutes, the headache went away, and a smile appeared on Kent’s face.
"Indeed, everything is a weapon inside this universe. And all I need is just Soul Essence."
The tomes that entered his forehead are the ways he can go about using the Soul Universe. Surprisingly, only the first three tomes gave him something; the seven left were locked inside his mind.
"Celestial Forge, Orbital Dominion, Stellar Cataclysm." Kent was puzzled by the names of the three tomes he had access to.
No, the names seemed fine. It was what they meant that left his jaw hanging loose. In fact, he never expected things to be this dangerous.
The Celestial Forge showed him how to create a vast array of entities, including planets, moons, suns, stars, beasts, asteroids, humans, and anything else it desires in its universe.
Of course, it is easier said than done, but that is a piece of cake to Kent.

But that isn’t all. It turns out that aside from creating these celestial bodies, he can also surround them with something called Cosmic Aura, which, according to the tome, enhances the effect of the celestial body.
So, if he manages to surround the moon with a Cosmic Aura, throwing it at his opponent wouldn’t just be a mere throw, but instead, it would contain the user’s will, and in this case, Kent’s will.
And if his will is strong enough, he can affect the laws of the known universe and, to some extent, take the laws of the known universe and make them his own for a limited amount of time.
In short, if his will is strong enough, aside from the force behind his thoughts, he can influence the gravity on the falling body, making it move several times faster.
Aside from that, he can increase the density, making it very heavy. The possibilities are endless...
"This is crazy. I mean, just where did this path come from?" Kent looked at his hand, and he could see he was clenching his fist in excitement. That shows just how powerful he felt at the moment.
